title: One slice's dispositions
description: What one rb-triage-rule fan-out member ruled over its own slice. minItems:1 on dispositions because a slice always holds at least one candidate (triage-slices refuses to emit an empty one) and every candidate in it is ruled: an empty part is a member that wrote nothing, not a member with nothing to say. observed_surfaces and deficiency_notes carry no such floor -- a slice can be fully ruled without surfacing anything new or flagging anything insufficient.

slice_id.description: Which 00-slices.json entry this part rules on. refs.check_disposition_parts holds every slice to exactly one part.

allOf.description: A member rules admit or decline and signs `triage`; `defer` and `authority: policy` are triage-seal's alone, written from the run's own --defer-kind declaration for candidates no member ever saw. The restriction is an overlay here rather than a narrowing of the shared $def because adoptions-0.1.json needs `human` and the sealed record needs all three disposition values -- narrowing the def would break gate-0 adoptions. It restricts existing property names only, so the referenced schema's additionalProperties: false still applies unchanged. Without it a member could defer a candidate the plan does not defer: that passes refs.check_disposition_parts, passes a conflict check that only sees plan-declared defers, and reaches the sealed record, dropping the input with no phase recorded anywhere and no reason code -- the invisible drop rb-triage-rule exists to prevent, and worse than a decline, which must at least carry a code from the decline set.

observed_surfaces.description: Surfaces this member noticed while ruling its slice that 00-objective.json's prediction did not already name -- the raw material for the design's section 4.1 divergence check, before triage-seal reconciles it against the objective pass's list.

deficiency_notes.description: Raw deficiency observations from this slice, not yet full $defs/deficiency records: rb-triage-audit reads every part's notes, deduplicates across slices, and consolidates them into 00-audit.json's deficiencies, which is where a deficiency_id is minted.
